title.en: Analysing chemical composition; primary and secondary metabolites
title.kn: ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆಯ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ; ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ವಿತೀಯಕ ಚಯಾಪಚಯಕಗಳು

heading.en: What is a leaf made of?

hook.en: Grind a leaf with trichloroacetic acid and filter it. What passes through and what stays on the filter paper tells us a lot about the molecules of life.
hook.kn: ಎಲೆಯನ್ನು ಟ್ರೈಕ್ಲೋರೋಅಸಿಟಿಕ್ ಆಮ್ಲದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅರೆದು ಸೋಸಿದರೆ, ಸೋಸಿ ಹೋಗುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಗದದ ಮೇಲೆ ಉಳಿಯುವುದು ಜೀವದ ಅಣುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಬಹಳಷ್ಟು ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Explain the acid-soluble and acid-insoluble fractions.
Describe amino acids, fatty acids, lipids and nucleotides.

narration.en: Grind a leaf with trichloroacetic acid and filter it. What passes through and what stays on the filter paper tells us a lot about the molecules of life.
narration.kn: ಎಲೆಯನ್ನು ಟ್ರೈಕ್ಲೋರೋಅಸಿಟಿಕ್ ಆಮ್ಲದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅರೆದು ಸೋಸಿದರೆ, ಸೋಸಿ ಹೋಗುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಗದದ ಮೇಲೆ ಉಳಿಯುವುದು ಜೀವದ ಅಣುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಬಹಳಷ್ಟು ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Living tissue is ground in trichloroacetic acid (Cl₃CCOOH) and strained. The filtrate is the acid-soluble pool and the retentate is the acid-insoluble fraction. Burning a tissue to ash gives the inorganic elements (ash) such as calcium, magnesium, sodium and potassium, and inorganic compounds such as sulphate and phosphate. Amino acids are substituted methanes: an α-carbon carrying a hydrogen, a carboxyl group, an amino group and a variable R group. There are 20 types of amino acids in proteins, e.g. glycine (R = H), alanine (R = CH₃) and serine (R = CH₂OH). Their ionisable –NH₂ and –COOH groups mean their structure changes with pH (the zwitterionic form).

points.en: Acid-soluble pool: compounds of molecular weight below 1000 Da (micromolecules).
Fatty acids: R group of 1–19 carbons; palmitic acid has 16 carbons including the carboxyl carbon; arachidonic acid has 20.
Lipids include glycerol esters (mono-, di-, triglycerides) and phospholipids such as lecithin.
Nucleotide = nitrogenous base + sugar + phosphate; nucleoside = base + sugar.

narration.kn: ಜೀವಂತ ಅಂಗಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಟ್ರೈಕ್ಲೋರೋಅಸಿಟಿಕ್ ಆಮ್ಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಅರೆದು ಸೋಸಿದಾಗ ಆಮ್ಲ-ವಿಲೇಯ ಮತ್ತು ಆಮ್ಲ-ಅವಿಲೇಯ ಭಾಗಗಳು ದೊರೆಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಅಮೈನೋ ಆಮ್ಲಗಳು ಬದಲಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ಮೀಥೇನ್‌ಗಳು. ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯೋಟೈಡ್ ಎಂದರೆ ಸಾರಜನಕ ಕ್ಷಾರ, ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಫಾಸ್ಫೇಟ್.

body.en: Compounds with identifiable functions in normal physiological processes, such as amino acids, sugars and nucleotides, are primary metabolites. Many plants, fungi and microbes also make secondary metabolites whose role in the host is not fully understood, though many are useful to humans. Examples: pigments (carotenoids, anthocyanins), alkaloids (morphine, codeine), terpenoids (monoterpenes, diterpenes), essential oils (lemon grass oil), toxins (abrin, ricin), lectins (concanavalin A), drugs (vinblastine, curcumin), polymeric substances (rubber, gums, cellulose).

points.en: Primary metabolites: known role in normal physiology.
Secondary metabolites: ecological importance, many used in industry and medicine.

narration.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಶಾರೀರಿಕ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾತ್ರವಿರುವ ಅಮೈನೋ ಆಮ್ಲ, ಸಕ್ಕರೆಗಳು ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಚಯಾಪಚಯಕಗಳು. ಆಲ್ಕಲಾಯ್ಡ್, ವರ್ಣಕ, ರಬ್ಬರ್ ಮುಂತಾದವು ದ್ವಿತೀಯಕ ಚಯಾಪಚಯಕಗಳು.

problem.en: Classify each as a primary or secondary metabolite: glucose, morphine, alanine, rubber, anthocyanin.

steps.en: Glucose and alanine have identifiable roles in normal metabolism: primary.
Morphine is an alkaloid, rubber is a polymeric substance, anthocyanin is a pigment.

answer.en: Primary: glucose, alanine. Secondary: morphine, rubber, anthocyanin

narration.en: Recap. The acid-soluble pool has small molecules; the acid-insoluble fraction has macromolecules. Amino acids have an amino group, a carboxyl group and an R group on the α-carbon. Nucleotide = base + sugar + phosphate. Secondary metabolites include alkaloids, pigments, toxins, lectins and drugs.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಆಮ್ಲ-ವಿಲೇಯ ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಅಣುಗಳು; ಅವಿಲೇಯ ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೃಹದಣುಗಳು. ಅಮೈನೋ ಆಮ್ಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಮೈನೋ ಗುಂಪು, ಕಾರ್ಬಾಕ್ಸಿಲ್ ಗುಂಪು ಮತ್ತು R ಗುಂಪು ಇವೆ. ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯೋಟೈಡ್ = ಕ್ಷಾರ + ಸಕ್ಕರೆ + ಫಾಸ್ಫೇಟ್. ದ್ವಿತೀಯಕ ಚಯಾಪಚಯಕಗಳು: ಆಲ್ಕಲಾಯ್ಡ್, ವರ್ಣಕ, ವಿಷ, ಲೆಕ್ಟಿನ್, ಔಷಧ.
